confidence_notes: Low confidence: Vang Vieng is a small town with thin, partly undated price data. Beer (~29,000 LAK avg, 0.5 L draught) and cappuccino (~34,000 LAK avg) rest on one aggregator site (combien-coute.net, citing Numbeo) seen via search, converted at an assumed ~22,000 LAK/USD that I did not source. Meal anchors blend that site's ~EUR 1.6 lunch with travel-guide ranges (USD 2-4 local, 4-8 tourist restaurants). Cocktail uses bar-review snippets (~30,000-50,000 LAK) and a ~2.2x beer ratio. No wine price was found, so wine is inferred at ~2.3x beer. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate from general knowledge (no listings or booking pages checked; July is low season) and is the least certain. FX is the RBA table value surfaced by one search, not independently re-verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Laos tourist-town basis: Luang Prabang and Vientiane price levels from general knowledge (not searched), adjusted with Vang Vieng-specific aggregator data and its backpacker/tourist-oriented market. Drink ratios follow typical Southeast Asian tourist-town patterns.
